about_the_game:
BAFTA-nominated composer Kevin Penkin returns for Defender's Quest II, bringing his bold and original soundscapes to your ears. This 48 minute original soundtrack is a an absolute treat and we were honored and thrilled to be able to include it in our game.

Kevin has reworked all of the tracks into non-looping versions and also remastered it in lossless WAV format for the true audiophiles out there!
